title: Longitudinal Back Kneading
summary: Soft tissue is gently gathered and worked along the muscle mass without sharp pinching.
goal: Gently work larger muscle areas after the tissues have been warmed up.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of longitudinal back kneading without text labels.
startingPosition: The person lies face down. Warm the tissues first with stroking or rubbing.
instructions: Place both hands over a soft muscular area.
Gently gather the tissue between the palms and fingers without pinching the skin.
Move slightly higher along the muscle and repeat.
Keep a slow rhythm and avoid working directly on the spine.
direction: Progress gradually along the long axis of the muscle mass.
tips: Gather soft tissue rather than pinching only the skin.
mistakes: Deep work without warming the tissue first.
warning: Do not perform this technique over acute pain, recent injury, significant inflammation, damaged skin, or when touch increases symptoms. Seek qualified professional advice when uncertain.
